about: SkyShards DljbseQj; the 39 plots submitted on 29 Oct 2026, including expanded fills and producer scripts. Commons use the unmodified SkyShards armor rare-crop rolls. Stocked plots: 3 seeds, 300 warm-up + 2000 measured cycles, intervals 1-14. Profit share credits chain by-products. Ironman: retargeted bootstrap flows, 9000 cycles, 1 seed per interval, empty mutation inventory (Dead Plants, Fire and Fermento free). Main/Alpha base-crop NPC prices revalue identical produced ledgers; other NPC drops unchanged. Mutation items count zero NPC value. Lonelily retained as an input. Jellybean + Shadevine (Default) is the exact bundled three-plot mixed flow, measured separately with 3 stocked seeds and 1 empty-start seed at every interval. Its per-plot view is the bundle average; counted Jellybeans are net of its own use. No dedicated-plot profit-share formula is assigned to it.
